plan: Given my value of $30, I aim to bid slightly above what I estimate other bidders might value the prize at, to maximize profit. Assuming others bid close to their value, I will bid $30.1 to potentially win while paying a lower price (the third-highest bid). This strategy balances winning chances with profit, as winning at a bid lower than my value ensures a positive return. I assume others will not exceed their value significantly, so bidding just over $30 should suffice.

Given my value of $35, I aim to bid slightly below my value to ensure a profit if I win. I expect others to bid around their values, likely between $0 and $49. By bidding $30, I maximize my chance of winning without overpaying. If others bid higher, I lose nothing. If they bid lower, I win and profit $5 or more. This strategy balances the risk of losing with the potential for profit.
